title: HOLD-LC-001 response-selection option set and time-coordinate owner gap
question: What exact implementation choices must be frozen before the official rsp2 nearest/interpolate/weighted options and Fermi time-coordinate conventions can enter a candidate-neutral observation map?
method: Read the official Fermi GBM response workflow, gbm.data.drm source documentation, time-system documentation, science-product format and coordinate utilities, recording bounded locators and retrieval date.

Crosswalk the documented nearest DRM, interpolation, boundary handling, count-weighted response and MET/TT/GPS/UTC/UT1 conventions against the hash-pinned EXP-001305 and EXP-001306 owner candidates without reading response matrix values.
Separate software option semantics from a source-owned physical validity/interpolation rule and list the version, boundary, coordinate and uncertainty fields required for admission.
Preserve T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules; do not score candidates or populate F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Official software-option and time-coordinate semantics plus owner-gap specification; no response matrix values, likelihood, candidate ranking, continuum, physical identity or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 P1 intake refinement; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The official workflow says an rsp2 time sequence requires choosing a response and exposes a nearest DRM or an interpolated DRM at the center of the selected interval.
official_sources.owner_boundary: This is an option description, not a preregistered physical validity or interpolation rule.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The documented implementation maps atime to a nearest/covering DRM, offers scipy.interpolate.interp1d over DRM center times with first/last fill outside coverage, and exposes a counts-weighted response path requiring weights and bin centers.
official_sources.owner_boundary: Library behavior and defaults must be version-pinned and independently reproduced; they do not establish source-owned uncertainty or candidate-neutral selection.

official_sources.semantic_finding: Fermi documents TT, MET, GPS and UTC relations, MJDREF convention and possible spacecraft clock drift when GPS is unavailable.
official_sources.owner_boundary: A time-standard convention is not a detector-to-geocenter light-travel correction or its uncertainty.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The product specification records GPS/MET/TT offsets, MJDREF and clock-drift handling and distinguishes GBM position/orientation systems from LAT systems.
official_sources.owner_boundary: Format and reference-frame semantics do not supply a timing likelihood or uncertainty budget.

official_sources.semantic_finding: The utilities expose spacecraft-coordinate transforms from quaternions and note that geocentric longitude may use UTC or UT1 with IERS corrections.
official_sources.owner_boundary: Coordinate transformation choices and Earth-orientation inputs must be frozen; they are not themselves a detector timing correction.

EXP-001305.products: one GS-006 position/attitude candidate and two GS-005 spectral-history candidates
EXP-001305.available: hash, FITS schema and TT-second coverage
EXP-001305.missing: attitude/ephemeris interpolation rule, validity intervals, detector-to-geocenter correction and uncertainty

EXP-001306.products: N0 and B0 rsp2 candidates with one EBOUNDS and eight numbered response segments per detector
EXP-001306.available: hash, segment numbering, header time coverage, response leaf/atmospheric linkage metadata and TT time standard
EXP-001306.missing: matrix values for analysis, source-owned segment validity/interpolation rule, uncertainty and statistical ownership

response_selection: A pre-registered choice among nearest, interpolation or counts-weighted response, with the selected interval-to-atime map.
If interpolation is selected, the scipy/gdt package versions, interpolation kind, center-time definition, segment ordering and boundary/extrapolation behavior.
A source-owned response validity interval and linkage from each selected PHA/CSPEC product to its rsp2 and leaf/atmospheric inputs.
A matrix and calibration uncertainty model that is common to every candidate and not tuned after residual disclosure.
time_coordinate: A single MET/TT/GPS/UTC/UT1 convention with MJDREF, leap-second and clock-drift data versions.
Quaternion/ephemeris interpolation, Earth-orientation (UTC versus UT1/IERS) choice and geocenter reference-frame definition.
A detector-to-geocenter propagation or light-travel correction algorithm with an independently reproducible uncertainty.
A common GW merger-time estimator and GBM onset/background/window owner.
reproducibility: A version-pinned implementation or source-owned artefact for every choice, plus an independent reproduction before candidate scoring.
A sealed prospective holdout and candidate-neutral F_reg output before any F_lim/F_eff/F_obs or score.

checks.detail: Primary Fermi documentation explicitly distinguishes nearest and interpolated response choices; the implementation documentation also exposes boundary handling and a counts-weighted path.
Primary Fermi documentation fixes the semantic roles of MET, TT, GPS, UTC, MJDREF, clock drift, spacecraft attitude and optional UTC/UT1 Earth rotation.
EXP-001305/001306 metadata are sufficient to enumerate the owner gap, but no source-owned validity, interpolation, detector-to-geocenter correction, uncertainty or statistical object is admitted.
T-054/T-059 methods, R-192 owner order, parked-loop registry and promotion firewalls are unchanged.

finding: The official GBM tooling narrows the implementation option set but leaves the physical-owner decision open: nearest, interpolation, and weighted response paths have different time maps and boundary behavior, while Fermi time and coordinate conventions still do not provide a detector-to-geocenter correction or uncertainty. The next admission must therefore freeze these choices before any response value is read or score is computed.
decision_reason: This is a new, source-grounded option-set and time-coordinate boundary that makes hidden implementation choices explicit; it is not a repeated generic owner request and it does not alter either proof lane.
decision_scope: T0 official software/time semantics and candidate-neutral owner-gap refinement only; no matrix-value inference, likelihood, candidate ranking, dynamic identification, empirical prediction or physical promotion.
assumptions: The cited official pages and source module represent the documented GBM Data Tools behavior at the recorded retrieval date.
EXP-001305 and EXP-001306 remain authoritative for exact local hashes and header-only observations.
Software defaults are not physical owner rules unless version-pinned and independently reproduced.
A coordinate transform, time standard or boundary clamp cannot be silently promoted to a timing correction or uncertainty.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned selection/interpolation/weighting rule and response validity intervals.
Pinned software/version/defaults and response boundary/extrapolation policy.
Common MET/TT/GPS/UTC/UT1, leap-second/clock-drift and Earth-orientation inputs.
Detector-to-geocenter propagation correction with uncertainty and GW/GBM timing-owner linkage.
Joint likelihood or covariance, intrinsic-lag treatment, complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs maps and sealed holdout.

adversarial_review.check: Could the existence of official nearest/interpolate methods justify selecting one after seeing candidate residuals?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the choice and atime map must be preregistered and common to all candidates.

adversarial_review.check: Could first/last DRM fill outside coverage be treated as physical validity or zero uncertainty?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: boundary behavior is software semantics and requires a source-owned validity/uncertainty contract.

adversarial_review.check: Could an unpinned scipy/gdt default silently change the response map?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: package versions, interpolation kind and kwargs must be hash-pinned.

adversarial_review.check: Could TT/MET/GPS conversion or UTC/UT1 choice be called detector-to-geocenter timing correction?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: propagation algorithm and uncertainty remain missing.

adversarial_review.check: Could this option-set card replace T-054/T-059?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is additive T-061 intake and preserves existing methods, owner order and parked-loop rules.

boundary: EXP-001308 is a T0 official-source implementation/time semantic refinement. It does not admit response values, calibration validity, interpolation, detector-to-geocenter propagation, uncertainty, likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 primary official-document and source-module crosswalk plus hash-pinned local owner candidates; no model or statistical test
next_action: Use the required-freeze list to seek a source-owned response selection/validity and time-coordinate/propagation packet. Until it is frozen, keep response values and scoring locked; continue unchanged T-054 owner intake and report any non-identifiability as an equivalence class.
stop_or_redesign: If no source owner supplies the selection/validity and propagation/uncertainty fields, keep HOLD-LC-001 at provenance/design-only and do not score.
If an implementation default is changed after target disclosure, invalidate prospective credit and issue a new version.
If response or time choices alter a finite result outside the declared uncertainty, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If no dynamic observable separates a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
non_claims: No response matrix value is read or admitted, and no nearest/interpolated/weighted response is selected for a candidate.
Official software semantics do not supply source-owned validity, uncertainty, likelihood, covariance or intrinsic-emission nuisance ownership.
This card does not establish a causal law, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity, microscopic dynamics or empirical prediction.
No physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this is additive owner intake, not a replacement.
